models_evaluated: supervised end-to-end deep learning LVEF model

links.outcome: Performance degradation of DL LVEF model on external versus internal data
links.effect: Performance degradation was observed compared with internal data when testing the model on external data; incorporating imaging domain knowledge helped recover performance and improve generalizability.
links.quote: For the generalization challenge, a performance degradation was observed compared with internal data when testing the model on external data.

links.outcome: Reliability of AUC as evaluation metric for dichotomized heart failure diagnosis
links.effect: AUC varied from 0.71 to 0.98 owing solely to changes in population characteristics, showing significant unreliability of the AUC.
links.quote: Specifically, AUC varied from 0.71 to 0.98 owing solely to changes in population characteristics.

unlisted_practices: Integrating imaging domain knowledge into deep learning framework to improve generalizability
Training data reduction/selection based on data distribution while maintaining performance

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating challenges and design strategies (such as metric selection, training set curation, and domain knowledge integration) across three datasets for DL-based left ventricular ejection fraction measurement, but it does not test specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
